title: core/stats_test.odin: unused local 'g' fails to compile, contradicting '162 tests green'
detail: g is never used after declaration. Odin rejects unused locals (this very file silences one elsewhere with '_ = before'), so the test file does not compile and the PR's '162 tests green' cannot have run.
recommended_fix: Change to 'r, _, h := test_seed_fixture(&replay, &cat)' (or use g), then actually run 'odin test core' before claiming AC5.

title: util_pct divides bandwidth units by packet-count cap — metric saturates to 0/100
evidence:
+		queued := u64(row.q[0]) + u64(row.q[1]) + u64(row.q[2])
+		row.carried = queued * bw
+
+		if row.cap_units > 0 {
+			pct := row.carried * 100 / u64(row.cap_units)
+			row.util_pct = u32(min(pct, 100))
+		}
+
+			testing.expect(t, p.cap_units == 15, "pipe 0 standard cap = 15")
+			testing.expect(t, p.carried == queued * 30, "carried = queued * packet_bandwidth(30)")
detail: carried is queued x 30 (bandwidth units) but the divisor is the raw cap 15: one queued packet yields 30x100/15=200, clamped to 100. The 50/70/90 heat bands are unreachable; carried 240 vs 180 are indistinguishable.
recommended_fix: Divide in consistent units: util_pct = queued*100/cap_units, or carried*100/(cap_units*packet_bandwidth), so intermediate utilization values exist.

title: App --stats-out write failure never exits 1, contradicting the spec's error contract
detail: The spec's I/O matrix requires 'eprintln + exit 1' on an unwritable path; the code only logs inside a defer and the process still exits 0.
recommended_fix: Record the failure flag in the defer and call os.exit(1) after cleanup, or amend the spec row to match the log-only behavior.

title: PR claims a 'seed column' disambiguates appended runs, but the G row has none
evidence:
+- **App restart appends** — a restart mints a fresh seed and appends the new run's
+  ticks to the same stream file (tick restarts at 1; the sim_hash + seed column
+  disambiguates runs). The overlay is per-run (the record is destroyed on restart).
+
+	fmt.sbprintf(sb, "G,%d,%d,%016x,%d,%d\n",
+		rec.tick, rec.gen, rec.sim_hash, rec.score, rec.meter)
detail: The PR body justifies multi-run appends by a seed column, but the G row serializes only tick, gen, sim_hash, score, meter — no seed or run-id exists in the format.
recommended_fix: Add a seed (or run-id) column to the G row, or delete the seed-column claim from the PR body.

title: Spec leaves the full-suite task unchecked while the PR body asserts it green
evidence:

+
+## Verification
+
+- `odin test core` — 162 tests green (158 existing + 4 new).
+- `tools/lint.sh` — all 6 gates green.

detail: The spec's AC5 task box is unchecked (suite not run) while the PR body claims the identical suite ran green — the two artifacts contradict each other on verification state.

title: overlay.odin header says PNG goes to _bmad-output/, code writes bin/
evidence:
+// overlay.odin — Story 5.7's AC3 verification verb: `overlay-check <demo> <ms>`
+// renders a demo frame WITH the debug overlay drawn on top (the SAME shipped
+// overlay code the app shows under `D` — render/debug_overlay.odin) and writes
+// a PNG to `_bmad-output/overlay-<demo>-<ms>.png` for the user to look at.
+
+	out := fmt.aprintf("bin/overlay-%s-%dms.png", demo, cap_ms)
detail: The file-header comment names _bmad-output/ as the output directory; the code (and the PR body) put the PNG in bin/. The comment misleads the verification workflow.
recommended_fix: Update the header comment to bin/overlay-<demo>-<ms>.png to match the code and the PR body.

title: overlay_on field is NOT compile-excluded, contradicting two comments
evidence:
+	overlay_on:  bool,   // 5.7: the D-key debug overlay (PP_DEBUG builds only)
+
+	// 5.7: the overlay is OFF by default (the D key toggles it; PP_DEBUG builds
+	// only — the field + toggle are compile-excluded without the define).
+	app.overlay_on = false
+
+				if app.stats_live || app.overlay_on {
detail: Both comments claim the field and toggle are compile-excluded without PP_DEBUG, but the struct field, its unconditional initialization, and its read exist in every build.
recommended_fix: Gate the field, init, and read under 'when #config(PP_DEBUG,false)', or fix the comments to say only the D toggle and draw call are gated.

title: Spec Code Map/Tasks omit the two new harness files the diff adds
evidence:
